query: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), and Item 8 Financial Statements and Supplementary Data sections specifically covering "Income Taxes" and "Commitments and Contingencies".

extraction.tax_onetime_note: One-time income tax charge of $10.2 billion net ($15.8 billion payable to Ireland, partially offset by a U.S. foreign tax credit of $4.8 billion and a decrease in unrecognized tax benefits of $823 million) recorded in Q4 2024 due to the European Court of Justice confirming the European Commission's 2016 State Aid Decision.
extraction.tax_contingency_note: The Company believes it is reasonably possible that its gross unrecognized tax benefits could decrease by as much as $6 billion in the next 12 months due to potential resolutions or closures of tax examinations.
